module.title: System Context and Dynamic Enumerations
module.business_purpose: Provides versioned system context for agents, modules and workflows, and database-driven enumerations resolved from governed terminology value sets. Consumers receive reproducible context instead of ad-hoc JSON or hard-coded lists.
